_comment: Page mapping for each book PDF. Used by /study-pack to convert printed page numbers to PDF page indices. Formula: pdf_index = (printed_page + offset) // scale, where pdf_index is 0-based (PyMuPDF); the 1-based page a PDF viewer shows is pdf_index + 1, so notes saying 'printed p.1 -> PDF 13' mean offset 11. Offsets were re-based from 1-based to 0-based on 2026-10-13 (all entries except MWG, which was already 0-based) after the Aulas 1-2 study pack came out one page late; checked against page headers. Verified offsets should not be re-detected. MWG entries carried over from Microeconomia 01-MPE (byte-identical PDFs).
